name: Nanjou Kyouka
source: A student in [url=http://vndb.org/c1633]Kouhei[/url]'s class. She has a grudge against [url=http://vndb.org/c1630]Aeka[/url] and is the reason why the class picks on her so much. She likes to flirt with everyone, especially [url=http://vndb.org/c1633]Kouhei[/url]. [url=http://vndb.org/c1633]Kouhei[/url] doesn't like her though and gives her the nickname Antoinette, after [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Antoinette]Marie Antoinette[/url], because of her attitude and personality.
